g.text: Solid bars: conditional, independence unverified. Triangles: test adjustments, no intervals.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Dashed purple bars: rounding ranges for FPR; unknown attack weights plus rounding for TPR.
These are identification ranges, not confidence intervals. * K10 TPR requires extra assumptions.
All 24 descriptive points retained; K03 and K11 hypothetical intervals are supplementary only.
